# Reading indexed `$or` plans with explain — facts

## Definitions

- [statement] An indexed query is not necessarily covered. Coverage means satisfying filtering and returned fields from index keys without fetching documents; a covered read has zero documents examined. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/explain-results/ · keywords: Reading indexed `$or` plans with explain · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/tutorial/analyze-query-plan/

## How it works

- [statement] A 2023 Percona forum reporter observed a large $or latency change when adding recurrence to the projection despite apparently equal plans and the same two branch indexes. The thread does not establish the root cause; compare the exact projected operations and execution statistics before attributing such a difference to index choice. (low confidence) — https://forums.percona.com/t/or-query-with-projection-significantly-slower-than-in-mongodb-distribution/24786 · keywords: Reading indexed `$or` plans with explain
- [statement] FETCH above IXSCAN can retrieve requested documents even when the index resolves the filter. A filter attached to FETCH identifies additional document-level predicate evaluation; FETCH alone does not prove residual filtering. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/tutorial/analyze-query-plan/ · keywords: Reading indexed `$or` plans with explain · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/mongodb-investigate-queries-with-explain-index-usage-part-2/

## How-to and procedures

- [statement] Run find(filter).explain("executionStats") to examine the winning plan and its execution counters. Compare totalKeysExamined and totalDocsExamined with nReturned when assessing the work done for matching results. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/tutorial/analyze-query-plan/ · keywords: Reading indexed `$or` plans with explain · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/mongodb-investigate-queries-with-explain-index-usage-part-2/, https://www.sgmoratilla.com/2022-02-14-mongodb-performance/

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] For sorted OR queries, distinguish merging ordered scans with SORT_MERGE from a separate SORT. SERVER-24027 illustrates that branch scan directions must provide compatible ordering for the merge; its reported scan-direction defect concerns MongoDB 3.2.3, not a demonstrated current limitation. (medium confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-24027 · keywords: Reading indexed `$or` plans with explain · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/explain-results/

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] IXSCAN establishes index use, not complete filter coverage or efficiency. FETCH reads collection documents and may apply residual filtering; compare totalKeysExamined and totalDocsExamined with nReturned instead of approving a plan from its stage names. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/explain-results/ · keywords: Reading indexed `$or` plans with explain · also: https://www.sgmoratilla.com/2022-02-14-mongodb-performance/
- [statement] Sorted indexed $or branches can use SORT_MERGE rather than an OR node followed by a blocking SORT. MongoDB's historical SERVER-51120 diagnosis explicitly identifies SORT_MERGE with IXSCAN children for such queries. (medium confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-51120 · keywords: Reading indexed `$or` plans with explain · also: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/36490738/how-does-sorting-work-with-or-and-in-queries-in-mongodb
- [statement] For contained $or queries, common predicates can be distributed into branches. Indraneil Seal illustrates category AND (price OR quantity) and competing category/price and category/quantity indexes; inspect the chosen tree rather than inferring access paths from query syntax. (medium confidence) — https://indraneilseal.ca/2024/05/20/how-mongodb-choose-optimal-path-for-or-operator/ · keywords: Reading indexed `$or` plans with explain · also: https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-03-31-mongodb-index-for-or-queries/view

## Facts and statements

- [statement] An OR stage with multiple IXSCAN children in inputStages identifies indexed branch union. Read the whole tree: an enclosing FETCH or SUBPLAN can place OR below the root. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/explain-results/ · keywords: Reading indexed `$or` plans with explain · also: https://www.sgmoratilla.com/2022-02-14-mongodb-performance/, https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-03-31-mongodb-index-for-or-queries/view
- [statement] Compound indexes and union can coexist: Moratilla's example merges scans of owner_id/start_date and player_id/start_date indexes. Inspect each branch's indexName and indexBounds to determine which fields constrain that scan. (medium confidence) — https://www.sgmoratilla.com/2022-02-14-mongodb-performance/ · keywords: Reading indexed `$or` plans with explain · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/explain-results/
- [statement] The documented classic plan tree is directly under winningPlan; the slot-based engine exposes the logical tree under winningPlan.queryPlan and also emits slotBasedPlan. A reader must account for this structural difference. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/explain-results/ · keywords: Reading indexed `$or` plans with explain
- [statement] executionStats describes completed winning-plan execution. allPlansExecution adds partial execution captured during candidate selection; those trial figures are not full executions of every rejected alternative. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/explain-results/ · keywords: Reading indexed `$or` plans with explain
- [statement] In the documented indexed-OR tree, an OR stage has multiple IXSCAN children in inputStages. Moratilla’s example shows FETCH above OR with separate owner_id/start_date and player_id/start_date compound-index scans; compound indexes and branch union can coexist. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/explain-results/ · keywords: Reading indexed `$or` plans with explain · also: https://www.sgmoratilla.com/2022-02-14-mongodb-performance/
- [statement] Inspect every scan’s indexName, keyPattern, indexBounds and direction. These identify the index and scanned ranges; the presence of an IXSCAN alone does not show that every predicate constrained the scan. (medium confidence) — https://www.sgmoratilla.com/2022-02-14-mongodb-performance/ · keywords: Reading indexed `$or` plans with explain · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/mongodb-investigate-queries-with-explain-index-usage-part-2/
- [statement] totalDocsExamined counts examinations, including filtered-out documents and repeated examinations of the same document; it is neither the result count nor necessarily a unique-document count. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/explain-results/ · keywords: Reading indexed `$or` plans with explain
- [statement] Read winningPlan for the selected tree and rejectedPlans for alternatives. allPlansExecution adds partial trial statistics, which must not be treated as complete executions of every rejected candidate. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/explain-results/ · keywords: Reading indexed `$or` plans with explain · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/mongodb-investigate-queries-with-explain-index-usage-part-2/
- [statement] Two IXSCAN children do not by themselves identify an OR union. SERVER-106829 records identical scans beneath AND_SORTED in a rejected candidate, illustrating why both the parent stage and candidate location matter. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.3/reference/explain-results/ · keywords: Reading indexed `$or` plans with explain · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-106829
- [statement] In Moratilla’s indexed-OR example, start_date has an unbounded descending interval while owner_id or player_id has an equality interval. The compound-index name therefore does not imply that start_date narrows the filter. (low confidence) — https://www.sgmoratilla.com/2022-02-14-mongodb-performance/ · keywords: Reading indexed `$or` plans with explain
